body: Three people were killed when a Robinson R22 and an Airbus AS350B3 collided in flight near McMinnville Municipal Airport in Oregon. The helicopters came down in a farm field southeast of McMinnville, southwest of Portland, and emergency crews responding at about 2:10 p.m. on October 29, 2026 found two people in the Robinson and one in the Airbus; all three had died, according to the Yamhill County Sheriff's Office.

The Robinson was on an instructional flight carrying a 22-year-old flight instructor from Texas and a 31-year-old student pilot from the United Kingdom. The Airbus pilot, aged 38, was alone on a post-maintenance check flight, according to NTSB Air Safety Investigator Grant Mills at an October 30 briefing. Witnesses placed the helicopters about 500 feet above ground when they collided, roughly a mile east of the airport.

The Robinson belonged to Jerry Trimble Helicopters, a flight school based at the airport, which expressed condolences to those involved, their families and everyone affected. The Airbus pilot flew for Precision, which described him as a senior pilot and mentor and said it was supporting the victims' families and cooperating with the investigation. The National Transportation Safety Board is leading the investigation, and a preliminary report is expected in about 30 days. McMinnville Municipal Airport has no control tower, so pilots use a shared radio frequency to announce their positions and intentions at the uncontrolled field.
en.summary: Three people died when a Robinson R22 and an Airbus AS350B3 collided near McMinnville Municipal Airport in Oregon on October 29, 2026. The NTSB is leading the investigation, with a preliminary report expected in about 30 days.
en.title: Three killed in midair helicopter collision near McMinnville, Oregon

body: 一架羅賓遜R22與一架空中巴士AS350B3在奧勒岡州麥克明維爾市立機場附近空中相撞，造成3人死亡。兩架直升機墜落在麥克明維爾東南方的農田，位處波特蘭西南方；應急人員於2026年10月29日下午約2時10分抵達，在羅賓遜機上發現2人、在空中巴士機上發現1人，3人均已罹難，消息來自亞姆希爾郡警長辦公室。
羅賓遜當時正在執行教學飛行，機上有一名22歲、來自德州的飛行教官，以及一名31歲、來自英國的學員飛行員。空中巴士飛行員38歲，獨自執行維修後檢查飛行，相關說法來自美國國家運輸安全委員會航空安全調查員葛蘭特·米爾斯在10月30日簡報中的說明。目擊者表示，兩機相撞時高度約500英尺，位置在機場以東約1英里。
羅賓遜屬於以該機場為基地的飛行學校傑瑞·特林布爾直升機公司，該校向涉事人員、家屬及所有受影響者致哀。空中巴士飛行員任職於普雷西森公司，該公司稱他為資深飛行員與導師，並表示正支援罹難者家屬、配合調查。美國國家運輸安全委員會正主導調查，預計約30天內發布初步報告。麥克明維爾市立機場沒有管制塔台，飛行員在這座非管制機場以共用無線電頻率通報位置與意圖。
